name: Development Superpowers Harness
description: A Superpowers-inspired development harness for building this repository with explicit planning, implementation, test, review, and verification phases.

nodes.label: Use Superpowers
nodes.description: Start by identifying the workflow phase and loading only relevant skills.

nodes.label: Brainstorming
nodes.description: Clarify the desired outcome, constraints, risks, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.label: Writing Plans
nodes.description: Turn the selected approach into an executable plan.

nodes.label: Executing Plans
nodes.description: Implement the plan incrementally and keep state visible.

nodes.label: Test Driven Development
nodes.description: Use tests and programmatic checks to protect behavior.

nodes.label: Requesting Code Review
nodes.description: Perform a structured review before handoff.

nodes.label: Verification Before Completion
nodes.description: Summarize checks, known limitations, and completion status.
